g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Azure web application migrated from on-premises to VM Scale Sets across three zones

g.title: None.None.Node.33
g.text: Azure Migrate replicates the web servers across the site-to-site VPN
to its vault through a private endpoint, and the replicas become the image for the scale set
Database Migration Service reads the SQL Server database over the VPN
and keeps Azure SQL in sync until cutover
At cutover Azure DNS points the shop at Application Gateway's public IP
Application Gateway with WAF v2 balances requests across the scale set in three zones
Instances share sessions in Azure Managed Redis
and uploaded content on Azure Files
and query the zone-redundant Azure SQL database
Payments go to the provider through the NAT gateway
